_how_to_use: Two roles. 'basic' reads questions, looks at room crops and reviews wall spots. 'smart' is asked only when basic fails twice or says it is unsure; 'none' switches that second level off. To move to a newer model, change the name here (or set BP_MODEL_BASIC / BP_MODEL_SMART) and restart the server. The provider follows from the name: 'claude-...' uses ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, 'gemini-...' uses GEMINI_API_KEY, 'gpt-...' uses the codex command line, a bare name such as 'haiku' uses the claude command line.
_prices: US dollars per million tokens, used only for the cost shown on the page. A model with no entry is shown as 'price not set', never guessed. Add a line when you add a model.
